item.title: Zurrer: Huang’s Credibility in Industry Too Important (Video)
What's Next for Huang, Nvidia and the AI Trade?
item.description: Nvidia's reinstatement of Jensen Huang as chief executive officer doesn’t remove the cloud that still lingers over him and chipmaking giant. Huang is set to testify before the Senate Banking Committee on Dec. 3, while concerns also remain around the costs and risks of the AI buildout. Bloomberg's Neil Campling has more. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: US Blacklists Alibaba-Owned Company in Megaspeed Crackdown
item.description: The Trump administration blacklisted a Singaporean subsidiary of Alibaba Group Holding Ltd., roping one of China’s biggest tech companies into its crackdown on Megaspeed International, the firm at the center of a controversy that briefly cost Jensen Huang his job at Nvidia Corp.
item.dc:creator: Mackenzie Hawkins, Andy Lin and Luz Ding

item.title: Australia Bolsters Online Safety Law With Tougher Big Tech Fine
item.description: The world’s biggest technology providers may face fines of as much as 5% of their global revenue under Australia’s new Digital Duty of Care law after the government toughened penalties to secure its passage.
item.dc:creator: Angus Whitley and James Mayger
